# Mahmudul Hasan Riaz

> Software Engineer, Entrepreneur and Nasheed Artist based in Dhaka, Bangladesh. This site is his portfolio and personal brand platform: software engineering work, ventures, nasheed releases, and writing — in English and Bangla.

## Services

- ERP/CRM Development
- Custom Website Development
- Ecommerce Consultancy
- WordPress Website and Theme/Plugin Development
- Shopify Development

## Selected Projects

- [Jannat Fashion ERP](/projects/jannat-fashion-erp): Next.js ERP for Jannat Fashion — 2,000 to 5,000 orders a day across multiple WooCommerce stores, with payroll, accounting, fraud blocking, an SR portal and wholesale.
- [EcoMate](/projects/ecomate): single-tenant SaaS ERP and e-commerce platform — one Docker deployment per client, with inventory, POS, multi-branch and HR. Used by Fixed Plus and Avelto.
- [SurgicalX](/projects/surgicalx): WordPress e-commerce store for surgical products, built on Flatsome.
- [WooMate Lite](/projects/woomate-lite): WordPress plugin for Bangladeshi WooCommerce stores — fraud blocking, four courier integrations, and IP, phone and device blocking.
- [StyleNest](/projects/stylenest-fashion-ecommerce): fashion e-commerce — fixing a slow WooCommerce store with heavy cash-on-delivery fraud.
- [PharmaTrack](/projects/pharmatrack-pharmacy-erp): pharmacy ERP replacing paper registers across eighteen branches.
